_comment: Maps the literal colors your AE comps use onto CSS design-token classes.
This is data, not code: edit the hex list to match the colors your comps
actually use, and the token to match your stylesheet. Every future export
follows, with no code change and no re-export of anything else.
Every role carries a fill- AND a stroke- class, because a class that sets
fill will not color a stroked path.
The roles below are an example from an icon library. Rename them, add
more, or delete the lot and run the panel with Token classes unticked to
